events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war is escalating, with potential for further conflict in the Middle East. This could lead to increased volatility in oil prices and global markets. The US and its allies are considering further military action.
events.reasoning: The escalating conflict in Iran could lead to higher oil prices, benefiting oil services companies. On the other hand, emerging markets may be negatively impacted by the increased uncertainty and volatility.

timeFrame.note: Monitor oil prices and conflict developments

events.exitStrategy: Exit if oil prices drop below $60/bbl or if conflict de-escalates

gains.extendedNote: If conflict spreads to other countries

events.title: Nvidia AI Spending
events.summary: Nvidia has announced a multiyear technology partnership with SK hynix to advance memory for AI factories. This could lead to increased demand for Nvidia's AI-related products.
events.reasoning: The partnership with SK hynix could lead to increased demand for Nvidia's AI-related products, benefiting the company's stock price. Rotating from Intel to Nvidia could also be a good strategy, given Nvidia's stronger position in the AI market.

timeFrame.note: Monitor Nvidia's earnings and AI-related developments

events.exitStrategy: Exit if Nvidia's earnings disappoint or if AI demand slows down

events.title: US Interest Rate Hike
